custodyBinding.meaning: Only producer source-closure metadata is real. Every derived request/package remains synthetic protocol data, not Source-produced output or new official qualification; its own request/response hashes are independently recomputed.

derivation: Every record retains full request, pinned complete DTS and original raw symbol/function/module/initializer/annotation/export support. All applicable source/manifest/input/request/package/transport hashes are recomputed independently. Origin objects are test-controlled protocol values with zero producer OID; no Source execution or authority is asserted. Kernel records additionally freeze complete cold HIR, scope, fixed context, report and proof/error from the literal source behavior and stable published upper bounds.

errorLayerDecision.source: Every new-alias proof/admission failure uses r03-module-callable-source / r01-input-boundary / hir, including TS-legal multi-alias, cross-module, cycle and initialization-period call. Shape, identity and reconstruction retain their existing distinct layers.
